logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-04 robot-cell decision report. Render a clean vertical bar chart of measured energy per acceptance batch for four candidate packages: P1 6 kWh, P3 14 kWh, P2 40 kWh, P4 67 kWh, ordered ascending left to right. Draw all four bars to one linear scale with the P4 bar the tallest; label each bar with its candidate ID and exact value; every drawn height must match its stated value proportionally. Add a short annotation stating that all four candidates qualify (quality 86-100 against a floor of 80; defects 1-5 against a ceiling of 5) and that the client pick is P1, the unique energy minimum, 8 kWh ahead of P3, 34 ahead of P2 and 61 ahead of P4. Optionally include a thin reference line at the 6 kWh winning draw. Use a restrained palette: one neutral fill for all bars with a single accent color reserved for the client pick P1. No decorative imagery; white background, sans-serif labels, and a titled y-axis reading kWh per acceptance batch. This figure supports the report's energy-first recommendation of P1 and must remain verifiable against the trusted table.
